message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > poc.bin <<'EOF'
[Script Info]
Title: x
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: 1280
PlayResY: 720
[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding
Style: Default,Arial,20,&H00FFFFFF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H64000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,2,0,2,10,10,10,1
[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text
Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:01.00,Default,,0,0,0,,\N
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":34,"var":"data/size","code":"ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr)","note":"Fuzzer bytes are copied into a subtitle buffer and parsed as ASS input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The raw input is NUL-terminated and handed to the parser."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1344,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"Subtitle events are parsed from the attacker-controlled buffer."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"ev.Start / ev.Duration","code":"long long tm = ev.Start + ev.Duration / 2;","note":"Each parsed event is rendered at a timestamp derived from the parsed timing fields."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":40,"var":"track,event,t m","code":"ass_render_frame(ass_renderer, track, tm, nullptr);","note":"Rendering uses the parsed subtitle text, which can drive hash-table lookups for cached outline/glyph data."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"String-valued cache keys are hashed directly from their buffer pointer and length."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"When a zero-length string reaches the hash helper, the do/while loop still dereferences the buffer and crashes because empty strings are not handled."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '
---SUBMIT---'` executed with exit code 0.
